name: qemu-alpine-docker
description: Persistent QEMU Alpine Docker VM and status panel for Linux, Linux containers, and Windows.

interface.shortDescription: QEMU Docker on Linux and Windows, with a live status panel.
interface.longDescription: Manages a persistent Alpine Docker VM with KVM on Linux, WHPX on Windows, and portable TCG fallback. Runs inside ordinary Linux containers without privileged mode and exposes a read-only VM, service, and container status panel.
defaultPrompt: Set up a QEMU Alpine VM with Docker for development.
Start the Alpine VM and sync project code.
Run host Testcontainers tests against Docker in the Alpine VM.
